description: This file provides TypeScript type declarations for modules related to Microsoft Teams SDK, including classes, constructor signatures, methods, and types exported by various modules within the Microsoft Teams SDK ecosystem.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Represents a Microsoft Teams application with methods to retrieve bot and app graph tokens.

methods.name: App.constructor
methods.description: Initializes an App instance with client ID, client secret, and optional tenant ID.

methods.name: App.getAppGraphToken
methods.description: Retrieves the app graph token asynchronously.

methods.name: Client.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Client with a service URL and optional token and headers.

methods.name: conversations.activities
methods.description: Accesses conversation activities for a specific conversation ID.

methods.name: conversations.activities.create
methods.description: Creates a new activity in a conversation.

methods.name: JwtValidator.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a JWT Validator with specified options and optional logger.

methods.name: JwtValidator.validateAccessToken
methods.description: Validates an access token asynchronously, optionally verifying service URL.

methods.name: createServiceTokenValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator function for access tokens given app ID and optional tenant ID.
